Package library

Class LibraryManager

java.lang.Object
library.LibraryManager
public class LibraryManager extends Object
Holds the list of books and performs all library operations: add, view, find, update, delete and change status.

Books are stored in an ArrayList in memory only, so the data is lost when the application closes. Invalid operations throw an IllegalArgumentException with a message that can be shown to the user.

Author:
Narmeen Fatima, Faique Mustafa

  • Method Details

    • addBook

      public void addBook(String id, String title, String author)
      Adds a new Available book after validating the input.
      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the new book (must not be empty or already used)
      title - the title of the new book (must not be empty)
      author - the author of the new book (must not be empty)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the ID, title or author is empty, or if a book with the same ID already exists

    • getAllBooks

      public ArrayList<Book> getAllBooks()
      Returns a copy of the book list, so callers cannot change the internal list by accident.
      Returns:
      a new list containing all books in the order they were added

    • findBookById

      public Book findBookById(String id)
      Finds a book by ID using linear search.
      Parameters:
      id - the ID to look for (spaces around it and letter case are ignored)
      Returns:
      the matching book, or null if no book has that ID

    • updateBook

      public void updateBook(String currentId, String newId, String newTitle, String newAuthor)
      Updates the ID, title and author of an existing book.
      Parameters:
      currentId - the current ID of the book to update
      newId - the new ID (may be the same as the current ID)
      newTitle - the new title (must not be empty)
      newAuthor - the new author (must not be empty)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any value is empty, if no book has the current ID, or if the new ID already belongs to a different book

    • deleteBook

      public void deleteBook(String id)
      Deletes the book with the given ID.
      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the book to delete
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is empty or no book has that ID

      public void setStatus(String id, BookStatus newStatus)
